## Light and life
## to over a billion people

BHEL contributes more than 50% of the total power generated from conventional sources

As India’s foremost power equipment manufacturer, BHEL continues to play a pivotal role in
bolstering India’s energy security

## Harnessing the
## Power of Water

With dedicated design, engineering, erection & commissioning teams, BHEL is a one-stop solution for
Hydro Power Equipment

## Powering India
## Since 1964

With 200+ GW power generating capacity installed across the world, BHEL is the undisputed leader
amongst India's Power Plant manufacturers

## BHEL - Contributing to the
## Nation's self-reliance in the
## Aerospace sector

Chandrayaan 3 is equipped with BHEL manufactured Batteries for Lander Module & Propulsion Module &
Titanium Propellent Tank

## Fueling the Aspirations
## of Emerging India

Indigenously developed & supplied sucker rod pumps for oil & gas exploration

## Serving our sentinels
## for nearly four decades

BHEL is the sole indigenous supplier of compact heat exchangers for fighter aircrafts

## BHEL - a committed Corporate
## Citizen investing in ESG

300,000+ saplings planted in last five years

Miyawaki forests in three BHEL units with cumulative coverage of 15,500+ sq.m.

## Ensuring reliable Power
## Transmission across the nation
## with state-of-the-art equipment

The first & only Transformer Manufacturer in India having successfully short circuit tested Auto
Transformers up to 500 MVA, 400 kV Class and Generator Transformer up to 333 MVA, 765 kV Class

## Nuclear Energy - Powering a
## Sustainable & Clean Future

Only company associated with all three stages of Indian Nuclear Power Programme

## Technology Innovations
## for Sustainable Development

We invest around 2.5% of our turnover in Research & Development works

## Harnessing
## Nature's Power

We are actively working on renewable energy, energy efficient systems and low emission technologies

## Equipping
## Indian Defence &
## Paramilitary Forces

Regular supplier of Super Rapid Gun Mount Naval Guns for providing Anti-Shipping and Anti-Air
capability in addition to Naval Gun Fire Support for Land Based Operations

# ** A Journey That Began with a Clear Goal **

When CET Technology first started out in 1987, the first thing it did was make reliable high-quality
magnetic components USA. At that time, trustworthiness was more important than size. This way of
thinking has stuck around over time. Even though the company has grown and learned new tools, the
main idea hasn’t changed. As always, it’s all about making things that work well and stay well over
time. They work with a lot of different kinds of businesses these days. A few are still being worked
on, and some have very specific needs. This is done by the company to make things easier and better.

The main thing that CET Technology does is make electrical parts, especially high quality magnetic
components USA. Such things as chokes, DC/DC converters, transformers, and inductors are included.

they are necessary. The whole setup can be messed up if one part fails or doesn’t work as planned.

things done quickly, from design to production. Some clients know just what they want. To create the
right part, others need help. Businesses can move forward more quickly with the leading electrical
components manufacturer, CET Technology because it works with both types.

# Useful Cannabis Seed Strain Guide

There are countless cannabis seed varieties. There are so many cannabis varieties that nobody can
establish an exact count, as more are being bred. This is because the varieties are bred with each
other. Meanwhile you get every questionable cannabis seed variety available, but they are all based
on the same plant, the Cannabis Sativa. Cannabis varieties can vary in effect, price, cultivation,
appearance and other elements. Some of the most famous cannabis seed strains are certainly Crystal,
Chronic, Big Bud, Ice, White Widow, Northern Light and Super Skunk. But there are numerous other
cannabis seed varieties than only these.

Cannabis varieties can be split into four main groups/species. These are:
* Indica
* Cannabis Sativa
* Cannabis Ruderalis

## Indica Cannabis

Indica cannabis strains are typically small and dense. Well suited for the so-called "Homegrow",
where you grow hemp at home in your growbox. Despite the fact that the plant becomes relatively
small (about 1m), Indicas produce relatively many buds. There are Indica Cannabis varieties that
yield up to 600g per m² (about 4-5 plants). Indicas almost all come from Afghanistan, Pakistan,
India, Tibet, Nepal, etc. so mainly from South Asia. The effect is more physical and makes you
stoned, creating deep relaxation.

## Cannabis Sativa

Sativa comes from the equatorial regions. This variety continues growing during flowering, so
Sativas tend to grow very tall. In nature, these can grow up to many meters high. The leaves are
broad with many small leaflets.

## Cannabis Ruderalis

The name comes from "ruderal", a term for a wild growing plant. Ruderalis is indigenous to Russia,
Central Europe and Central Asia. They are very small, between 30-80 cm tall. The plant has very few
branches, but broad, bushy and light green fingers. As it has very low THC content, it is rarely
smoked but its genetics makes it very interesting for crossing.

# Saifon Technologies

— is a leading supplier of printed circuit boards and electronic components with a global standard
of quality
[Contacts][114]
[Order status][115]
[Online-calculator][116]
Since 2012, Saifon Technologies has been successfully engaged in professional design and a complete
production cycle of printed circuit boards
In accordance with design documentation and technical specifications of customers, international
technical and environmental standards. We also carry out tracing of printed circuit boards and
manufacturing prototypes according to customer requirements.

Since 2020, it has been supplying electronic components and modules.
About the company
[More about the company][117]
The company Saifon Technologies designs and produces a wide range of printed circuit boards of all
known types and classes of complexity:
Printed circuit boards
[Single-layer printed circuit boards][118]

[Double sided printed circuit boards][120]
[Semi-flex printed circuit boards][121]
[Multilayer printed circuit boards][122]
[HDI printed circuit boards][123]
[Flex printed circuit boards][124]
[IMS — insulated metal base printed circuit boards][125]
[HF — high frequency printed circuit boards][126]
[Planar transformers][127]

Saifon Technologies is an innovative PCB manufacturing and supply company with highly liquid
electronic components for electronics manufacturers.
Why us
Individual approach
Our partners are always valuable to us, and we strive to cooperate honestly and transparently,
creating optimal conditions for their maximum success and financial stability.
Responsibility to customers
We are attentive to the production processes, the results obtained and the quality of the products,
on which the reliability of the operation of complex electronic equipment and the reputation of our
customers depends.
Professionalism and teamwork
Our team consists of highly qualified specialists with an active life position, constantly
developing their skills, competence, ability to think, work and use experience collectively, which
makes it possible to quickly and effectively solve problems of any complexity
Constant and continuous development
Updating equipment and introducing new technologies to expand technical capabilities, improve the
quality of services provided and reduce production costs.
Trade secret guarantee
The business of our clients is important to us, and we make every effort to guarantee the
confidentiality of cooperation and protect the professional and corporate secrets of partners.
Environmental safety
We use only high-tech equipment and safe production methods to minimize the impact on human health
and the environment.
Guaranteed product quality
The company's production cycle is optimized in accordance with international management standards
(ISO 9001:2008), is constantly being improved and allows us to guarantee the highest quality of
products.
Not inertia and out-of-the-box thinking
We are always focused on the introduction of the most advanced technologies, the rejection of
template management and technical solutions in favor of innovative development.

As the strategic incubator of TSTY Electric, China's leading power equipment manufacturer, TSTYNICE
is headquartered in Shanghai Pilot Free Trade Zone. Leveraging 30 years of group expertise and the
Yangtze River Delta's strategic advantages, we deliver integrated **[power equipment
solutions][47]** through our dual "Smart Manufacturing + Service" approach.
 
Core Business:
Global exports of cost-effective electrical equipment including **[transformers][48]**, switchgear
and renewable energy systems, serving emerging markets across Southeast Asia, the Middle East,
Africa and South America.
Green energy innovation through smart grid solutions and commercial/industrial energy storage
products to accelerate global energy transition.
